name: ToolUniverse
summary: Marginal fit: Claude Code / Gemini CLI plugin wrapping 1000+ science tools, including named genomics/health tools (TCGA, GWAS Catalog, ClinicalTrials.gov) within a much broader catalogue
description: ToolUniverse (Zitnik Lab, Harvard Medical School; arXiv:2509.23426) is a large biomedical/scientific tool ecosystem shipped as a Claude Code plugin -- confirmed by direct fetch, its `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` wraps a single `tooluniverse` plugin sourced from `./plugin`, whose own `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` (also fetched directly) is embedded verbatim below -- and separately documented for Gemini CLI via a first-party `mcpServers` configuration recipe wiring the `tooluniverse-smcp-stdio` MCP server into `~/.gemini/settings.json` (https://zitniklab.hms.harvard.edu/bioagent/guide/building_ai_scientists/gemini_cli.html, fetched directly). Its own `plugin.json` names concrete genomics/health-research data sources -- TCGA, GWAS Catalog, NHANES, ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed, UniProt, PubChem -- a real, nameable relevance fact, not vague health branding. Marginal fit, flagged explicitly: ToolUniverse's actual scope (1000+ tools, 120+ skills) spans biology, chemistry, medicine, and general data science, of which genomics/health-research is a real but partial slice rather than the project's sole focus; this entry does not claim, and does not attempt, to enumerate ToolUniverse's full tool catalogue. Terms check: the repository's root `LICENSE` file (fetched directly) is the Apache License, Version 2.0, matching the `license` field in both `plugin.json` and the README. No slug collision against any existing entry in this registry.

plugin.name: tooluniverse
plugin.description: 1000+ scientific research tools for biology, chemistry, medicine, and data science. Access PubMed, UniProt, PubChem, TCGA, NHANES, GWAS Catalog, and hundreds more databases through a unified MCP interface. Includes 120+ specialized research skills for genomics, drug discovery, clinical analysis, protein variant interpretation, and more.

harnesses.installCommand:
claude plugin marketplace add mims-harvard/ToolUniverse
claude plugin install tooluniverse@tooluniverse
